name: Inushima Uta
source:
Uta is a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komainu]komainu[/URL], and Yomi's older twin brother. He has an aggressive personality and a sharp tongue. His delivery is sharp, but since he's trying to help, his intent isn't to be malicious. As the ayakashi's leader of sorts, he gets along with them.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
